notes.title: Luthier Dev Blog #1 – The Journey of Legendary Guitars Begins!
notes.content:
[p]Hello dear guitar enthusiasts,[/p][p]This is my very first dev blog about [b]Luthier[/b], and I couldn’t be happier to share it with you![/p][p]In this post, I’ll talk about what awaits you in the game, its current state, and my future goals.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073190/fd0fb5577eed277637d0dc5c950f4665536d58ad.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Luthier[/b] is an action roguelike, dungeon crawler game set in a world where guitars are used as weapons. You play as a [b]Luthier[/b], a master instrument maker, who specializes in crafting guitars. The ultimate goal is to forge the legendary guitar [b]Lucielle[/b] and use it to defeat the game’s final boss. But the path to this goal won’t be easy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073190/ffafe32c548a8cf59fcb79f4f294e51cedf9f0bb.png"][/img][/p][p]To build Lucielle, you’ll first need to conquer dungeons, defeat their bosses, and gather the required materials. Along the way, you must craft guitars suited to your playstyle. Each guitar comes with two unique abilities and a distinct fighting style some swing heavy like a berserker, while others strike swiftly like a katana. On top of that, you can imbue your guitars with extra powers, such as fireballs, lightning strikes, or even a bull rush, creating your own personalized combat style.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073190/8d298ee8f9e0860d9b35860ba7cd7b05751863be.gif"][/img][/p][p]One of the most important aspects of the game is that while exploring dungeons, you’ll also choose various upgrades to create unique [b]builds[/b]. Additionally, you can sell the guitars you craft in your shop and use the earnings to unlock permanent upgrades for your character.[/p][p]Currently, the game is moving closer to a playable demo. As a solo developer, the workload is heavy, but since this is my [b]dream game[/b], I’m doing my best to make it as polished as possible. I hope to share an exciting demo with you in the near future.[/p][p]In the full version of the game, you can expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]3 dungeons[/b] to conquer,[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs you can build social relationships with,[/p][/*][*][p]Shop customization features.[/p][/*][/list][p]After release, I also plan to add free updates with new dungeons, upgrades, and more content. If this project sparks your interest, you can support me right now by spreading the word and adding the game to your wishlist. Every wishlist gives me huge motivation to keep going![/p][p]If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to me.
Thank you all so much, and see you soon![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073190/4988f0042a32ab51632a90dc723519a96c6fee13.png"][/img][/p]
